review_findings.finding: Computes only q targets. No scene, rigid-object, force, torque, fixture, or simulator-state writes.
Reset reference is target FK; Cartesian delta and FK share base axes. Current scene Robot base has translation only, so axes match world. A future rotated base would require rotating world deltas.

Position target is clamped in command space; final nonlinear two-iteration FK can have a small numerical boundary residual. Joint targets are limited to URDF bounds and <=0.025rad per control interval.

Exact zero retains all previous actuator targets, including preload; it intentionally does not re-centre based on measured actual q. Mechanical disturbances remain handled by articulation position actuators.
Workspace limits constrain commanded FK, not every actual tool/finger point; this is not collision avoidance or a proof of task contact stability during motion.
